title: Rune Construction cost/stability/progression deterministic benchmarks
authority_note: Expected SCI/CSL/progression values are proposal-stage deterministic QA expectations for the candidate contract. They are not source-derived power, mana, XP, failure-probability or balance values.

cases.title: Single atom literacy
cases.acceptance: A single payload source stays easy to explain and does not acquire a resource or failure number from syntax alone.

cases.title: Directed sequential construction
cases.acceptance: Optional directional detail increases explainability load without implying more power or instability.

cases.title: Simple shaped payload
cases.acceptance: Source-plus-shape remains a small reusable construction; its actual fire power/cost comes from owning references.

cases.title: Triggered ward
cases.acceptance: WHEN raises progression/stability attention while actual inscription materials/DC remain external adapters.

cases.title: Conditional grouped push
cases.acceptance: Conditional logic and optional direction produce an advanced explainability score but no automatic failure chance.

cases.title: Parallel mixed-payload composite
cases.acceptance: WITH and a second payload add composition-stability load; final resource and balance values remain owning-rule inputs.

cases.title: Synchronized prepared macro
cases.acceptance: Two LINK atoms plus prepared-macro context require the highest proposal progression band even though SCI remains standard.

cases.title: Item-bound inscription
cases.acceptance: Rune extension metrics do not transfer Item ownership; capacity/charge/material/DC values remain PPIA-03/crafting adapters.

cases.title: Expert nested reactive macro
cases.acceptance: The builder shows decomposition and stability-review warnings; the contract still does not invent a failure percentage or damage result.

cases.title: Unresolved applicable resource adapter
cases.acceptance: No universal mana default is substituted; draft inspection remains possible and the unresolved input is shown.

cases.title: Source-scoped adapter value retained
cases.acceptance: A resolved source/owning-rule mana value is displayed and consumed as scoped input, not converted through a rune-wide formula.

cases.title: Counterplay remains external
cases.acceptance: Grammar/SCI/CSL validity does not bypass resistance, counterspell or disruption rules.

cases.title: Progression-price conflict retained
cases.acceptance: The Scripts & Macros progression conflict remains provenance-visible; the candidate band does not silently choose one source XP price.

cases.title: Permission-filtered hidden resource/reference
cases.acceptance: Structural syntax may be scored without revealing hidden target/resource facts; labels, existence and external values remain filtered.

cases.title: Idempotent inscription recovery
cases.acceptance: Ambiguous writes do not duplicate resource consumption or the inscription.

cases.title: Invalid grammar receives no authoritative metrics
cases.acceptance: The parser requires explicit grouping before any authoritative cost/stability/progression decision is made.
